Supplier contract clauses.payment: The retainer is invoiced monthly in advance. Invoices are due within 30 days.
Supplier contract clauses.renewal: The parties may extend this agreement by agreeing in writing before it ends.

Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract meets the policy on payment terms, but is missing a liability cap and public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The retainer is invoiced monthly in advance. Invoices are due within 30 days.
findings.note: Payment is due within 30 days, as the policy asks.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability.
The contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The parties may extend this agreement by agreeing in writing before it ends.
findings.note: The contract can only be extended by agreement, so it does not renew automatically.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
